item.title: Captures: a poll's « Voir les résultats » answer and the page after (#684)
item.body:
Refs #684 (the capture its `### Blocked by` asks for; what is left: the port of the button and its confirmation, which becomes `status: ready` once this merges)
Claim: mac/M1
Author model: opus-5.5 (mac/M1)
Reviewer model: fable-5.2 (mac/M1-r1045-fable: APPROVE on dfdab29d with 3 low findings, fixed; APPROVE on d66c5dff; APPROVE on 22065d14, the head: the corpus sweep of `HopResponsePollVoteTests` counts W684)

## What
Three captures of HFR's « Voir les résultats » on a poll, taken on 2026-11-17 with **user2** on a public poll it had not answered (the operator's go on #684: user2 never votes). The operator's own poll (`R83`) could not be used: user1 voted there (`W42`), and the linked accounts share the vote (`W44`).

| Id | What |
|---|---|
| `R684a` | The topic, user2 not voted: `/user/vote.php` form with **two submits**, `sondage_submit=Voter` and `sondage_submit=Voir les résultats` |
| `W684` | The POST, legacy's body: the form's hidden fields + `sondage_submit=Voir les résultats`, no `reponse` (`PollData.swift:45-80` @ 2fe43da3). Answer: link-less `.hop` « Votre vote a bien été pris en compte ! », refresh to page 1: **the same answer as a vote** (`W42`) |
| `R684b` | The topic right after: no vote form; the results block (bars, percentages, counts, « Total : N votes (M votes blancs) ») and the multipseudo notice |

Protocol: a new `Poll results` row in `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md` §5. It records the "votes blancs" total as an observation only: one capture cannot show that this action was counted as a blank vote.

What this means for the port: a client cannot tell « Voir les résultats » from a vote by the answer sentence. It knows which one it sent, and the page after shows the results either way.

## Anonymization
- `publish.py` with the local config. The poll's answer texts (member pseudos) and one member named in a post's text went to the local `extra_pseudos` list, which is never committed.
- `anonymize.py check --corpus`: 721 of 721 files clean.
- **Independent leak check** (a separate Sonnet sub-agent, `mac/M1-leak684-sonnet`, its own patterns over the raw files, LESSONS 33): PASS. Its one undecided word was checked and turned out to be a member's pseudo. It is now aliased, and a re-check of all 54 `pseudo=` values of the raw list finds 0 hits in the 6 committed files.
- Raw captures and the user2 session cookies stay outside the repository and are deleted after the merge.

## Checks
`python3 -m unittest discover tooling/fixtures/tests` (corpus and MANIFEST agree), pre-commit green.

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (fable-5.2, mac/M1-r1045-fable, dfdab29d)** — APPROVE

Six committed files, no leak found; the three captures show what the MANIFEST rows and the §5 row claim (two `sondage_submit` submits and 4 `reponse` radios in `R684a`; link-less `.hop` "Votre vote a bien été pris en compte !" with `Refresh … /hfr/<cat>/<sub>/sujet_44713_1.htm` in `W684`, identical in shape to `W42`; `R684b` has no `vote.php` form, the `div.sondage` results block, "Total : 320 votes (71 votes blancs)" and the multipseudo notice). `W684.meta.json` body = `R684a`'s hidden fields in document order + `sondage_submit=Voir+les+r%C3%A9sultats`, no `reponse`; timestamps 17:48:44 → 17:49:05 → 17:49:21 are consistent. `Refs #684` is right (the feature stays open). Findings are wording only:

1. **Low** — `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md:125`: columns 4 and 5 are swapped. "Refusals captured" holds "not captured: logged out, already voted" and "Not captured" holds "—". Scenario: a reader filtering the table by the "Not captured" column misses both states. Fix: "—" in col 4; "logged out, already voted, refresh from a form page other than 1" in col 5 (as the `Poll vote` row).
2. **Low** — `MANIFEST.md:328` (W684) and `HFR-PROTOCOL.md:125` say "legacy's body" / "hidden fields only". The sent body is the form in document order with `hash_check` twice (as `W42`, whose row says "form order"); legacy's `[String: String]` (`PollData.swift:54`) sends each field once, unordered. The capture proves the form-order body is accepted, not legacy's exact one. Fix: "form order, no `reponse`; the field set of `PollData.swift:45-80`".
3. **Low** — `HFR-PROTOCOL.md` §6c (`LOT-026 — poll` line 286, `LOT-054 — poll vote` line 651) is not updated: AGENTS §5.2 puts verified facts in §6c, and the LOT-054 "Answers" bullet still names only `W42`-`W44`. Fix: one bullet naming `R684a`, `W684`, `R684b` and HFR's own warning text of `R684a` ('Attention si vous cliquez sur "voir les résultats" vous ne pourrez plus voter'), a better source for "can no longer vote" than `PollView.swift:167-174` (LESSONS 17).
4. **Detail** — `R684a.meta.json:5`, `R684b.meta.json:5`: `url_template` is the concrete URL; the corpus mostly templates topic pages (`/hfr/{forum}/{subcat}/{slug}-sujet_{post}_{page}.htm`). Precedent exists; harmless.

**Verified** (disposable worktree of `dfdab29d`, removed): `anonymize.py check --corpus` → 721 of 721 clean; `python3 -m unittest discover tooling/fixtures/tests` → OK, corpus and MANIFEST agree; greps over the 6 files: every `pseudo=`, `class="s2"` author and poll answer is `userN`, profile ids `910001`-`910007`, every `hash_check` `REDACTED`, no e-mail, no `md_*` value, no `<a` in `W684`'s `.hop`; a capitalised-token scan of the 35 message bodies found no member name; §5 row has 9 pipe-separated cells like its neighbours; `corpus.d/684-poll-results.json` matches the fragment format.

---

**Adversarial review (fable-5.2, mac/M1-r1045-fable, delta d66c5dff)** — APPROVE One commit (`d66c5dff`) over `dfdab29d`, three files, wording only; findings 1-3 of the first round are fixed as asked and nothing new is wrong. 1. Columns (finding 1) — `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md:125`: "Refusals captured" is now `—`, "Not captured" holds "logged out, already voted, refresh from a form page other than 1". The row still has 9 pipe-separated cells, as its header (line 118) and neighbours (124, 126). 2. Body wording (finding 2) — `MANIFEST.md:327` and the §5 row say "form order (`hash_check` twice, as `W42`), no `reponse`" with `PollData.swift:45-80` as the field set only. Matches `W684.meta.json`'s body, which is `W42`'s shape minus `reponse` with the other submit. 3. §6c (finding 3) — new bullet under `LOT-054 — poll vote` (line 657) names `R684a`, `W684`, `R684b`; the quoted warning `Attention si vous cliquez sur "voir les résultats" vous ne pourrez plus voter` is byte-identical to the committed `R684a` (lowercase "voir", straight quotes, no trailing punctuation), and the "same shape as `W42`" and "no vote form" claims hold on the committed pages. No finding. Finding 4 (`url_template` form) left as agreed. **Verified**: `git diff dfdab29d..pr-1045`; `awk -F'|'` cell counts on lines 118/124/125/126 (9 each) and MANIFEST rows 326-328 (7 each, as the table); `grep -c -F` of the warning sentence on the committed `R684a` (1 hit, ending ``); `W684` vs `W42` `request_body` compared with digits masked. Committed files only; no raw capture, no local config; local `pr-1045` branch deleted, nothing pushed or commented. --- Agent: mac/M1-r1045-fable (Fable), posted verbatim by mac/M1. _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Adversarial review (fable-5.2, mac/M1-r1045-fable, delta 22065d14)** — APPROVE

One commit over `d66c5dff`, test file only (`HopResponsePollVoteTests.swift`): `W684-poll-view-results-answer` joins the expected success set of the `.pollVote` corpus sweep, with the reason in the doc comments.

Right fix, not a hidden misclassification: `W684` is byte-for-byte the shape the classifier accepts under `.pollVote` (link-less `.hop`, the whole vote sentence, refresh to the topic page), because HFR confirms « Voir les résultats » with the vote's own answer (`W684` vs `W42`). A `.pollResults` context would apply the same rule to the same bytes: a speculative abstraction (AGENTS §4); the port of #684 reuses `.pollVote` and knows which submit it sent, as the new §6c bullet says. The `Context.pollVote` doc (`HopResponseParser.swift:28-29`) can take a clause then, not now.

The sweep still catches a real misclassification: `#expect(successes == Self.pollVoteConfirmations)` is set equality, so an extra or a missing capture fails.

No finding.

**Verified** (disposable worktree of `22065d14`, removed; macOS, Swift 6.4.2): `swift test --filter HopResponsePollVoteTests` → 7 tests passed; same suite with the test file reverted to `d66c5dff` → the sweep fails with `successes → [W42, W45, W684]` vs `[W42, W45]` (fails without the change, L01); the other whole-corpus sweeps (`HopResponseAlertTests`, `HopResponseParserTests`, `HFRLinkRouteCorpusTests`, `OracleOwnershipTests`, `StaleSessionNoticeParserTests`) → 44 tests passed. Lint by hand (no local swiftlint): longest line of the file 133 chars (< 140 warning), `git diff --check` clean.
